instruction: Fix `count_occurrences` to count only non-overlapping occurrences. It currently advances one character at a time even after a match.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils.py b/textutils.py
--- a/textutils.py
+++ b/textutils.py
@@ -65,5 +65,7 @@
     while i < len(text):
         if text.startswith(sub, i):
             count += 1
-        i += 1
+            i += len(sub)
+        else:
+            i += 1
     return count
